notes.title: Hotfix #1 — Movement Speed Change, Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Base movement speed for the player has been increased

Fixed an issue, that caused temporary slowdowns from specific interactions to never reset, making it impossible to complete certain puzzles

notes.title: Release Date Reveal & New Demo
notes.notes:
Ayo!

You read the title, you clicked “Read more” you know what time it is. Hope you brought your headphones!
[previewyoutube="MbAbLddvyuc;full"][/previewyoutube]
We’re beyond excited to announce that Eclipsium will finally launch on Steam on September 19th! That’s less than a month from now and, to be honest, that’s equal parts exciting and terrifying. It’s our first game as a studio, and, frankly, the release date is a pants shitting level event.

Here’s what we’ve cooked up for you:

A layered story through a nightmare-fueled world, that we’ve infused with as much emotional weight as we possibly can.

Fantastical body horror that will hopefully make you squint your eyes a little. And maybe say “Ew!”. But, it’s tasteful also.

Unique handcrafted locations—church like slaughterhouses, cursed forests, at some point you’re falling in a neverending, repeating space!

Visuals have gotten a glowup—we have honed and refined the art style that defines Eclipsium, while minimizing pesky head aches.

Over 20 tracks of custom-written, intense songs to go with the dreamlike visuals. Each one a banger.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091159/7bc408f05210589f3bb38e3546168c03a6651180.gif"]


But, don’t take our word for it-you can experience a slice of it for yourself: we just dropped a new demo!

What are you still doing here? Try it out right this instant.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419670/Eclipsium/"][/dynamiclink]Please let us know what you think about it!


And if you’re looking for other games to tickle your nerves, take a look at Carimara: Beneath the forlorn limbs – a creepy whimsy about asking the right questions to the weird inhabitants of its grove. Are you willing to lay your head in order to realise someone else’s wish?



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570370/CARIMARA_Beneath_the_forlorn_limbs/"][/dynamiclink]

‘til next time!

Housefire Games & CRITICAL REFLEX
